name: Themofy Addons for Elementor
author: themofy

sections.description:
Themofy Addons brings Elementor Pro features to the free version of Elementor, in one lightweight plugin:

  • Theme Builder — design your header, footer, blog posts, archives, shop, product pages and 404 page with Elementor, and choose where each one appears.
  • Form Builder — contact, quote, booking and multi-step forms with conditional fields, file uploads, emails, saved submissions and spam protection.
  • WooCommerce Checkout Builder — one or two columns or a two-step checkout, reorder, rename and hide fields, set their widths per device, and add your own fields to orders.
  • 54 widgets — Form and Checkout, 13 general widgets (Heading, Creative Button, Icon List, Accordion, Category Grid, Advanced Slider, Testimonials, Creative Gallery, Animated Progress, Timeline, Marquee, Circle Text, Off-Canvas), 12 blog widgets, 22 more WooCommerce widgets and 5 site widgets, each with full style controls.
  • Custom Fonts — upload your own fonts or import Google Fonts to your own site, and pick them in any Elementor typography control.
  • Custom Attributes — add data-*, aria-* and other HTML attributes to any element.
  • Mouse Trails — 21 designs (sparkles, confetti, neon line, ring cursor, comet, emoji, your image…) for the whole site, one page or one section.
  • Scroll & Loop Animations — on any element: effects that follow the scroll and reverse when you scroll back, and 24 loop animations, forever or a set number of times.
  • Dynamic Tags — fill any widget field with live site data: post titles, featured images, custom fields, ACF fields, WooCommerce prices and more.

Turn each widget on or off under Themofy Addons → Widgets. Widgets you turn off are not loaded at all, so your site stays fast.

In the Elementor panel, the Themofy widgets come right after General (choose another place under Themofy Addons → Settings). The widgets made for what you are editing get a group of their own: product widgets in a Single Product template, post widgets in a Single template, site widgets in a header or footer.

Formerly Themofy Dynamic Tags for Elementor.

Theme Builder

Create a template, design it in Elementor, and pick where it appears with display conditions — no coding needed.

Templates you can build

  • Header and Footer — replace your theme’s header and footer on the whole site or on selected pages.
  • Single Post / Page — the layout of blog posts, pages or any custom post type.
  • Archive — blog, category, tag, author, date and search result pages.
  • Single Product and Product Archive (Shop) — your WooCommerce product pages, shop and product categories.
  • 404 Page — a custom “page not found” page.
  • Section — a reusable block you place anywhere with a shortcode.

Display conditions

Show each template on the entire site, archives, the blog, search results, categories, authors, posts, pages, specific posts or pages, the front page or the 404 page, and exclude any of them. When several templates fit, the most specific one is used.

Build headers and footers with the Site widgets (Site Logo, Site Title, Nav Menu with dropdowns and a side, full-screen, top or bottom mobile panel, Search Form inline or as an icon opening a popup search, Copyright). While you design a single post or product template, the editor shows one of your real posts or products.

As in Elementor Pro, post widgets appear in Single templates and product widgets in Single Product templates; site widgets, Blog Posts, Advanced Product Grid, Breadcrumb and Cart Icon work everywhere. Works with classic themes (Hello Elementor, Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP…) and block themes (Twenty Twenty-Five).

Form Builder

The Form widget builds any form with full style controls for labels, fields, checkboxes, buttons, steps and messages.

  • 17 field types: text, email, textarea, phone, URL, number, date, time, drop-down (single or multiple), radio buttons, checkboxes, acceptance, password, file upload, hidden, HTML text and steps. Each field has a column width per device, placeholder, default value, help text and its own ID.
  • Multi-step forms with a progress bar or numbered steps with titles; each step is checked before moving on.
  • Conditional fields: show a field only when another field is, is not, contains, is empty or is not empty.
  • File uploads with allowed types, size and number of files. Files are stored with random names in a folder that can’t run scripts.
  • Actions after submit: save to Themofy Addons → Submissions, email, confirmation email to the visitor, redirect and webhook (Zapier, Make, n8n…). Emails use merge tags such as [field id="email"] and [all-fields], with From, Reply-To, Cc and Bcc.
  • Submissions page: list, search, filter by form, read / unread, delete and CSV export. Submissions are included in WordPress’s personal data export and erase tools.
  • Spam protection without third-party services: honeypot, minimum time before sending and an optional math question.

WooCommerce Checkout Builder

The Checkout widget shows WooCommerce’s own checkout, so payment gateways, coupons, shipping and order emails keep working, in a layout you design.

  • Layouts: order summary on the right, left, above or below, sticky if you like. The layout uses its own grid, so theme styles can’t break it.
  • Two-step checkout (optional): details first (checked before moving on), then payment with a summary of the details. Numbers, breadcrumb or progress bar as the step indicator.
  • Payment methods in the order summary or below the customer details.
  • Field editor for billing, shipping and additional fields: drag to reorder, change labels and placeholders, add default values and help texts, make fields required or optional, hide them, and set each field’s width per device (100%, 75%, 66%, 50%, 33%, 25% or a custom width).
  • Custom checkout fields (text, textarea, drop-down, radio, checkbox, email, phone, number, date) saved on the order and shown in the order screen, WooCommerce emails and the customer’s order details.
  • Order summary: product images with quantity badges, an “Edit cart” link and a coupon field right in the summary (or WooCommerce’s coupon link above the checkout), and your own texts for the headings and the Place Order button.
  • Style everything: sections, headings, labels, fields, steps, the order summary, payment methods, the Place Order button and notices.

General widgets

Building blocks for any page, each with full style controls.

  • Heading — write words in double braces, like Build pages that {{stand out}}, to style them on their own, with drawn-in effects (underline, marker, circle, zigzag…), an optional sub title, description and separator.
  • Creative Button — 23 hover effects (liquid fill, border beam, gradient flow, neon, letter wave, glitch, magnetic, pointer spotlight…), repeating attention animations, a click ripple and layered shadows. Follows your Site Settings button style and global colors and fonts. The icon has its own style.
  • Icon List — icons, your own SVGs, images or short texts such as numbers, with descriptions and links, as a list, inline or grid.
  • Accordion — icons or images beside the titles, rich content with an image, one or several items open, your own toggle icons, three designs and optional FAQ schema.
  • Category Grid — product or post categories, tags or any taxonomy as a grid or list, with image, count, description and button, nine designs and seven hover effects.
  • Advanced Slider — slides with an image, video or color background, overlay, heading, text, two buttons and a side image. Eight templates, seven effects, slides per view per device, autoplay with a progress bar, Ken Burns, text animations, and many arrow and pagination styles.
  • Testimonials — carousel, grid, masonry or marquee in eight templates, with photo, name, role, company, logo, rating and badge. Build your own card: drag the parts into any order and give each a width to place them side by side.
  • Creative Gallery — any layout: a grid where each item has its own size, nine patterns (bento, metro, magazine…), masonry, justified rows or a free canvas. Drag items to size and place them in the editor. Images, videos and text tiles from your list, the Media Library or posts, with filters, Load More, lightbox, captions and hover effects.
  • Animated Progress — bars, circles, gauges with a needle or segments in six designs, filling and counting up as they come into view or as the page scrolls, plus a reading progress bar at the top.
  • Timeline — zigzag, one side or horizontal, with dot, icon, number or date markers and five designs; the line fills as visitors scroll. Your own events or posts.
  • Marquee — an endless strip of texts, logos and icons with icon, symbol, image, dot or line separators: ribbons, tilted or crossed ribbons, outlined or gradient text, up to three rows in any direction, slow down or pause on hover, speed up while scrolling.
  • Circle Text — text around a circle with an icon, image or text in the middle. Spin and scroll motion; the middle animates separately.
  • Off-Canvas — a side, top, bottom or popup panel you design right on the page with any widgets, opened by its button or any link.

Blog widgets

Design your blog page, archives and single posts. Every widget has full style controls.

  • Blog Posts — six ready-made designs, as cards, a list or overlays. Show the posts of the page being viewed or choose them by post type, category, tag, IDs, order and offset, with badge, meta, excerpt, Read More button and pagination.
  • Archive Title — the category, tag, author, date or search title with its description.
  • Post Title, Featured Image (ratio, link, lightbox, caption, fallback image) and Post Excerpt.
  • Post Meta — author with photo, date, last updated, categories, tags, comments, reading time and custom text, in any order, each with its own label and icon.
  • Post Content — the post content, with styles for text, links, headings, quotes, images and lists.
  • Post Terms — categories, tags or any taxonomy, as text, pills or a list.
  • Author Box — photo, name, biography and a link to the author’s posts.
  • Post Navigation — previous and next post, with titles, arrows and thumbnails.
  • Related Posts — posts from the same category or with the same tags.
  • Post Comments — the comment list and form, fully styled.

WooCommerce widgets

Build your own product pages, shop and cart icon, with full style controls for every part.

  • Advanced Product Grid — products on any page, with five ready-made designs (Elevated Card, Outline, Minimal, Soft and Dark): latest, featured, on sale, best selling, top rated or hand-picked, filtered by category and tag, with columns per device and optional pagination. Or build your own card: choose and order the parts, set their widths to place them side by side, add a custom button and an image background.
  • Product Title — any heading tag, optional link.
  • Product Images — WooCommerce’s gallery with zoom, lightbox and thumbnail slider, optional slider arrows, thumbnail columns and sale flash.
  • Product Featured Image — the main image alone, any size, linked to the product or opened in a lightbox, with hover effects.
  • Product Price — sale and regular price styled separately, inline or stacked, currency symbol and price suffix.
  • Add to Cart — quantity, button, variation choices, grouped products and stock, side by side or stacked.
  • Add to Cart Button — the Creative Button that adds any product to the cart from any page, with quantity and redirect.
  • Product Rating, Product Stock (colors for in stock, out of stock and backorder) and Sale Badge (with the discount percentage).
  • Short Description and Product Description.
  • Product Meta (SKU, categories and tags with your own labels), Product Categories and Product Tags (as text, pills or a list).
  • Additional Information — the attributes table, with striped rows.
  • Product Tabs — normal, hover and active tab styles, and the panel.
  • Product Reviews — the reviews list and the review form, fully styled.
  • Related Products — related products or upsells, with columns per device and the same ready-made designs.
  • Products Archive — the shop grid with result count, sorting, pagination and the same ready-made designs.
  • WooCommerce Breadcrumb and Cart Icon (live item count and subtotal, your own icon).

Product widgets show the product being viewed (or one picked by its ID) and print WooCommerce’s own templates and hooks, so themes and extensions keep working.

Dynamic Tags

Dynamic tags let a widget field show live site data. Free Elementor has the system but no tags; Themofy Addons provides them, for text, links, images, galleries, colors and numbers, in classic and Elementor 4 (V4) widgets.

  • Post: Post Title, Post Excerpt, Post URL, Post ID, Post Date, Post Time, Post Terms, Reading Time, Featured Image, Featured Image Data, Post Attached Images.
  • Archive: Archive Title, Archive Description, Archive URL.
  • Site: Site Title, Site Tagline, Site URL, Site Logo, Page Title, Current Date Time, Request Parameter, Shortcode.
  • Author: Author Name, Author Info, Author URL, Author Profile Picture.
  • User (the logged-in visitor): User Info, User Profile Picture.
  • Comments: Comments Number, Comments URL.
  • Custom Fields: Custom Field (text, link, number or color), Custom Field Image, Custom Field Gallery — any custom field (Meta Box, Pods, plain WordPress meta…) from the current post, archive term, post author, logged-in user or an ACF options page.
  • ACF (when Advanced Custom Fields is active): ACF Field, ACF URL, ACF Image, ACF Gallery. Pick the field from the list; values come out ready to use (images, links, choices, dates, Group sub fields).
  • Links: Contact URL (email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Viber, Skype, Google Maps, Waze), Internal URL, Login / Logout URL.
  • WooCommerce (when WooCommerce is active): Product Title, Product Price, Product Sale Badge, Product Short Description, Product SKU, Product Stock, Product Rating, Product Attribute, Product Data, Product Image, Product Gallery, Product Category Image, Add To Cart URL, Store Page URL, Cart Info.

Every product tag works with the current product or a product picked by ID. Any tag can be switched off under Themofy Addons → Dynamic Tags.

Themofy Addons is an independent plugin. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elementor Ltd., WooCommerce or Advanced Custom Fields.

External services

Only the Import Google Fonts screen (Themofy Addons → Custom Fonts) uses outside services, and only when an administrator opens it:

  • WordPress.org font collection — the list of Google Fonts and its preview images come from the font collection that WordPress itself provides (s.w.org), the same one the Site Editor uses. Requested when the screen loads, and kept for a week. WordPress.org privacy policy.
  • Google Fonts (fonts.gstatic.com) — when you click Import, the font files you chose are downloaded once to your Media Library. No site or visitor data is sent, and your pages never load anything from Google for these fonts. Google Fonts privacy FAQ, Google privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Themofy Addons” and click Install Now. Elementor must be installed and active.
  2. Go to Themofy Addons → Widgets and turn off any widgets you don’t need.
  3. Theme Builder: go to Themofy Addons → Theme Builder, add a template, choose its type and display conditions, publish it, then click Edit with Elementor.
  4. Dynamic Tags: edit any page with Elementor and click the dynamic tags icon next to a field.
sections.faq:
I used Themofy Dynamic Tags. What changed in 2.0?

Only the name and the new features. Your dynamic tags, your designs and the tags you switched off are kept. The tag settings moved from Settings → Themofy Dynamic Tags to Themofy Addons → Dynamic Tags. The new Theme Builder and widgets change nothing on your site until you use them.

How do I use my own fonts?

Go to Themofy Addons → Custom Fonts, click Add New Font, name it and upload its files for each weight and style (WOFF2 is best; WOFF, TTF and OTF work too). The font then appears under Custom Fonts in every Elementor typography control, including Site Settings. Visitors download a font file only on pages that use it.

Can I use Google Fonts without loading them from Google?

Yes. Go to Themofy Addons → Custom Fonts → Import Google Fonts, pick a font and the styles you need, and click Import. The files are downloaded once to your Media Library, and the font appears under Custom Fonts in Elementor. Pages then load it from your own site, so no visitor data is sent to Google. Importing needs WordPress 6.5 or newer.

How do I lay out the Creative Gallery freely?

Choose a Layout: Grid (with an optional pattern), Masonry, Justified Rows or Free Canvas. In a grid, give any item a Size under Items → Placement, or drag the purple handle on its corner in the editor. On the Free Canvas, drag items to place them and drag the corner to resize them. Sizes are set per device, and an item is never wider than the gallery.

How do I add a reading progress bar?

Add the Animated Progress widget anywhere on the page (or in your header template) and set Mode to Page Reading Progress. It sticks to the top or bottom of the screen and fills as visitors read.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. Everything works with the free version of Elementor. If Elementor Pro is active too, its own tags are listed as well; you can switch off duplicates under Themofy Addons → Dynamic Tags.

Does it work with other Elementor addons, such as ElementsKit, Royal Elementor Addons or Jeg Kit?

Yes. Every widget, tag, style and script has its own Themofy name, so nothing is replaced or restyled by the other plugin, and you can use their widgets and ours on the same page. If another plugin’s header and footer builder also has a header or footer for a page, the Themofy template is used on the pages where it applies (so the page never gets two headers), and theirs everywhere else. Our templates don’t apply to the templates of other builders while you edit them.

How do I style one word of a heading differently?

In the Heading widget, wrap the words in double braces: Grow your {{business}} today. Style them under Style → Focused Text and pick an effect under Focused Text Effect. You can mark several parts of one heading.

Where do form messages go?

To the addresses you set under Actions After Submit → Email, and (with “Save to Submissions”) to Themofy Addons → Submissions. If emails don’t arrive, your site probably can’t send email yet: an SMTP plugin fixes that. Saved submissions are kept either way.

How do I use the Checkout widget?

Add it to a page and set that page as the Checkout page under WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced, so “Proceed to checkout” buttons and the order confirmation lead there. In the editor the checkout shows a sample product when your cart is empty.

How do I make a two-step checkout?

In the Checkout widget, open Steps and switch on Two-Step Checkout. Customers see their details first and continue to payment once the required fields are filled in. If WooCommerce finds a problem with a detail when the order is placed, the customer is taken back to the details step. Choose Show in the Editor to design either step.

How do I change the width of a checkout or form field?

Open the field in the list. In the Checkout widget, its Layout tab has Width; in the Form widget, it’s Column Width. Pick a preset, or Custom for a width of your own, and switch the device icon to set a different width on tablets and phones.

Are form uploads safe?

Only the file types you allow are accepted, files are checked by their content, renamed to random names and stored in wp-content/uploads/themofy-forms/, where scripts can’t run.

How do I turn widgets off?

Go to Themofy Addons → Widgets, switch off the widgets you don’t use and click Save Changes. They disappear from the Elementor panel and nothing of theirs loads on your site. Pages that already use a widget you turn off will no longer show it.

How do I build a product page?

Go to Themofy Addons → Theme Builder, add a template of the type Single Product, choose where it applies (all products, or some), publish it and click Edit with Elementor. Add the product widgets from the Themofy Addons group. The editor shows one of your products while you design.

Why don’t I see Product Title or Post Meta on a normal page?

Like in Elementor Pro, widgets that show a part of the current post or product appear only in the templates where they work: post widgets in Single templates, product widgets in Single Product templates. Create the template in Themofy Addons → Theme Builder and edit it with Elementor to find them. To show products on a normal page, use Advanced Product Grid (set Show to Hand-picked Products for specific ones); for posts, use Blog Posts.

Which slider templates are there?

Hero (centered text), Fullscreen with Ken Burns zoom, Minimal with left text, Split (text with an image), Floating Card, Bold Promo, Card Carousel and Coverflow Gallery. A template sets the layout, look and motion; any effect, pagination or spacing you choose yourself replaces the template’s, and the Style tab changes the rest.

How do I build my own testimonial card?

In the Testimonials widget, open Structure and switch on Customize the Structure. Click Start From: The Template’s Structure to begin with the parts of the chosen template, then drag the parts in the list to reorder them. Add Group: Start and Group: End around parts to put them in a row or a column, and open any part to set its alignment, width, spacing or a free position on the card (for example a photo in a corner).

Why are some widgets in a group at the top of the panel?

That group holds the widgets made for what you are editing, such as the product widgets in a Single Product template or the site widgets in a header. All other Themofy widgets are in the Themofy Addons group, as before.

Are there ready-made designs for the grids?

Yes. In Blog Posts, Related Posts, Advanced Product Grid, Products Archive and Related Products, choose a Design under the layout settings. Every design is a starting point: the Style tab controls change any part of it, including the image width, height, fit and alignment, the image frame, the card padding and the content padding. Choose Plain (theme styles) to use only your theme’s styles.

My template doesn’t show on the site

Check that the template is published, has been designed with Elementor (the templates list says “Not designed yet” otherwise) and has a display condition that matches the page.

Two templates match the same page. Which one is used?

The most specific condition wins: a specific post beats “All Posts”, which beats “All Singular”, which beats “Entire Site”. If two templates are equally specific, the newest one is used. Exclusions always win.

How do I show the post content in a single template?

Add the Post Content widget where the article should go. For blog and category pages, use the Blog Posts widget and set Posts to Posts of the Current Page.

Can I use a template inside a page?

Yes. Create a template of the type Section and paste its shortcode, shown in the templates list, into any page — for example with Elementor’s Shortcode widget.

Can I add scripts to a template with Elementor’s HTML widget?

No. For security, template output is filtered with WordPress’s wp_kses(), which removes <script> and <style> tags. Style your templates with Elementor’s controls, and add tracking or chat scripts with a dedicated plugin. The post content itself is printed by WordPress unchanged. Developers can adjust the allowed HTML with the themofy_tb_allowed_html filter.

Why is a dynamic tag empty in the editor?

The editor previews tags against the page you are editing. Archive tags only have a value on archive pages, User tags only for logged-in visitors, and Custom Field tags only when the field has a value on that page.

My ACF field shows nothing

Use the tags in the ACF group and pick the field from the list. A field group key (it starts with group_) is not a field and never has a value. The field also needs a value on the post being shown; otherwise the tag is empty or shows its Fallback (under Advanced).

Why can’t the Custom Field tag show some keys?

Keys that look like passwords, tokens, secrets, sessions or capabilities are always blocked so they cannot be printed on a public page. The “ACF Options Page” source only reads ACF options fields (options_{field_name}), never arbitrary site options. Developers can adjust the block list with the themofy_dt_is_sensitive_meta_key filter.

Does the Cart Info count update when something is added to the cart?

Yes. The tag loads WooCommerce’s cart fragments script, which refreshes the count, subtotal and total after an AJAX add-to-cart and when a cached page is loaded.

What does the Add To Cart URL do for variable products?

Variable and grouped products need options chosen first, so the link goes to the product page instead. External products link to their external URL. Out-of-stock products link to the product page.

My shortcode’s form or iframe is stripped

Shortcode output is limited to the HTML allowed in post content. Developers can allow more tags (such as form, input or iframe) with the themofy_dt_shortcode_allowed_html filter.

How do I add my own dynamic tag?

Create a class that extends \Elementor\Core\DynamicTags\Tag (text output) or \Elementor\Core\DynamicTags\Data_Tag (URLs, images, galleries) and add its class name through the themofy_dt_tag_classes filter. Use one of the plugin’s groups, e.g. \ThemofyAddons\DynamicTags\Plugin::GROUP_SITE. Tags written for 1.x with \ThemofyDynamicTags\… class names keep working.
sections.changelog:
2.7.0

  • New: Off-Canvas widget: a panel from the right, left, top or bottom, or a popup in the middle, with five animations, opened by its button, an icon or any link to #its-name (also on page load). Its content is designed right on the page with any widgets: in the editor the panel opens while you work on it. Overlay, close button, Esc, scroll lock, keyboard support and full styling.
  • New: Search Form → Show As → Icon That Opens a Popup: full screen, a centered box, a bar from the top or a small box under the icon, five animations, heading, hint, popular searches, close options, an editor preview and full styling.
  • New: Add to Cart Button widget, the Creative Button with all its effects that adds a product to the cart on any page: current product or one picked by ID, quantity field, text after adding, stay or go to the cart or checkout.
  • New: Accordion → Content Image: width, max width, height, fit and alignment, and an Image Width for each item.
  • New: Product grids → Image → Image Box: width, height and alignment. Its background now has Normal and Hover tabs.
  • Improved: Nav Menu mobile panel close button: an icon that theme button styles can’t break, never pushed out by a long heading or wide logo, with color, background, size and radius controls.
  • Improved: the Nav Menu mobile panel, the search popup and Off-Canvas cover the whole screen even inside a section with a blur, transform or animation (a glass or sticky header).
  • Fixed: a Nav Menu panel button without a link took the color of the text around it in some themes.
  • Changed: Product Grid is now called Advanced Product Grid; existing grids are unchanged.
  • Changed: Testimonials → Customize the Structure works like the product card builder: drag the parts into any order and give each a width (they sit side by side), rows to span (a photo beside the name and role), alignment, margin, padding and background. Groups and free positioning are gone; cards customized before show their parts one under the other until you click Start From → The Template’s Structure or set the widths.

2.6.0

  • New: Scroll & Loop Animations (Advanced → Themofy Motion, on every element): 23 scroll effects (fades, blur, zooms, rotate, 3D flips, wipes, circle reveal, parallax, spin, custom) that follow the scroll and reverse, play in and back out, or play once, with start and end points, strength, smoothing, duration, delay and speed curve; and 24 loop animations (float, bob, breathe, sway, drift, orbit, blob morph, bounce, pulse, heartbeat, rubber band, tada, jump, spin, swing, wobble, bell ring, hand wave, shake, flash, glow, rainbow) forever or a set number of times, always, while on screen or on hover. Per device; they combine with each other and with Elementor’s Transform.
  • New: Product Grid → Card Layout → Custom: choose the parts (image, title, price, rating, categories, tags, descriptions, stock, SKU, sale badge, add to cart, custom button, text, divider), drag them into any order and give each a width so parts sit side by side; second image on hover.
  • New: Product grids: Custom Button (product page, add to cart or your own URL with {product_name}, {sku}, {price}… e.g. a WhatsApp order link), also on the default card; Image Background behind product images.
  • New: Nav Menu → Mobile Menu → Opens As: side panel from the right or left, full screen, from the top or bottom sheet, with heading or logo, close button, optional button, backdrop, links appearing one by one and full keyboard support.
  • New: Creative Button → Layered Shadows: as many outset or inset shadows as you like, with a separate set on hover.

2.5.0

  • New: Mouse Trails: 21 designs (lines, neon, rainbow, lightning, ring cursor, comet, snake, sparkles, dots, magic dust, stars, confetti, bubbles, hearts, fire, smoke, ripples, pixels, emoji, your letters or image) with colors, size, amount, duration, opacity and blend mode; for the whole site (Settings, with a live preview), per page (Page Settings: site trail, none or its own) and per element (Advanced → Mouse Trail, optionally kept inside it); can replace the cursor. Not shown on touch screens or with reduced motion.
  • New: Circle Text widget: text around a circle (clockwise or facing in, spread evenly or with its own spacing) with an icon, image or text in the middle; the ring spins, spins on hover (pause, slow down, speed up or reverse) or turns with the page scroll, and the middle pulses, spins, bounces, floats, glows… always or on hover; entrances for both; inner ring line.

2.4.0

  • New: Custom Attributes: Advanced → Attributes on every widget, container, section and column, one name|value per line (Elementor Pro’s setting name, so they carry over to Pro).
  • New: Themofy Addons → Settings: choose where the Themofy Addons group appears in the Elementor panel (now right after General by default) and switch Custom Attributes on or off.
  • New: Creative Button: ten more hover effects (liquid fill, icon circle expand, border beam, gradient flow, neon glow, letter wave, glitch, magnetic, pointer spotlight, jelly), repeating attention animations (pulse, glow, shine, border beam, heartbeat, bounce, shake, wobble, float) and a ripple on click.
  • Improved: Creative Button follows Site Settings → Theme Style → Buttons and the global Accent color and font, also when Elementor’s default colors and fonts are disabled (Site Button Style, on by default).

2.3.0

  • New: Marquee widget: texts, images, logos and icons with separators (icon, symbol, image, dot, line, optionally spinning); plain, ribbon, tilted, crossed, outlined and logo designs; up to three rows, any direction, speed in pixels per second, slow down or pause on hover, speed up or follow the page scroll, faded edges.
  • New: Custom Fonts → Import Google Fonts: browse all Google Fonts with previews, pick the styles you need and import them to your Media Library, so pages load them from your own site.
  • Improved: the Themofy mark in the admin header comes alive on hover.

2.2.0

  • New: Creative Gallery widget: grid with per-item sizes and nine patterns, masonry, justified rows or a free canvas; drag to size and place items in the editor; images, videos and text tiles from your list, the Media Library or posts; filters, Load More, lightbox, captions, hover effects and entrance animations.

short_description: Theme builder, form and checkout builders, custom and Google fonts, gallery, marquee, 52 widgets and 50+ dynamic tags for free Elementor.
description:
Themofy Addons brings Elementor Pro features to the free version of Elementor, in one lightweight plugin:

  • Theme Builder — design your header, footer, blog posts, archives, shop, product pages and 404 page with Elementor, and choose where each one appears.
  • Form Builder — contact, quote, booking and multi-step forms with conditional fields, file uploads, emails, saved submissions and spam protection.
  • WooCommerce Checkout Builder — one or two columns or a two-step checkout, reorder, rename and hide fields, set their widths per device, and add your own fields to orders.
  • 54 widgets — Form and Checkout, 13 general widgets (Heading, Creative Button, Icon List, Accordion, Category Grid, Advanced Slider, Testimonials, Creative Gallery, Animated Progress, Timeline, Marquee, Circle Text, Off-Canvas), 12 blog widgets, 22 more WooCommerce widgets and 5 site widgets, each with full style controls.
  • Custom Fonts — upload your own fonts or import Google Fonts to your own site, and pick them in any Elementor typography control.
  • Custom Attributes — add data-*, aria-* and other HTML attributes to any element.
  • Mouse Trails — 21 designs (sparkles, confetti, neon line, ring cursor, comet, emoji, your image…) for the whole site, one page or one section.
  • Scroll & Loop Animations — on any element: effects that follow the scroll and reverse when you scroll back, and 24 loop animations, forever or a set number of times.
  • Dynamic Tags — fill any widget field with live site data: post titles, featured images, custom fields, ACF fields, WooCommerce prices and more.

Turn each widget on or off under Themofy Addons → Widgets. Widgets you turn off are not loaded at all, so your site stays fast.

In the Elementor panel, the Themofy widgets come right after General (choose another place under Themofy Addons → Settings). The widgets made for what you are editing get a group of their own: product widgets in a Single Product template, post widgets in a Single template, site widgets in a header or footer.

Formerly Themofy Dynamic Tags for Elementor.

Theme Builder

Create a template, design it in Elementor, and pick where it appears with display conditions — no coding needed.

Templates you can build

  • Header and Footer — replace your theme’s header and footer on the whole site or on selected pages.
  • Single Post / Page — the layout of blog posts, pages or any custom post type.
  • Archive — blog, category, tag, author, date and search result pages.
  • Single Product and Product Archive (Shop) — your WooCommerce product pages, shop and product categories.
  • 404 Page — a custom “page not found” page.
  • Section — a reusable block you place anywhere with a shortcode.

Display conditions

Show each template on the entire site, archives, the blog, search results, categories, authors, posts, pages, specific posts or pages, the front page or the 404 page, and exclude any of them. When several templates fit, the most specific one is used.

Build headers and footers with the Site widgets (Site Logo, Site Title, Nav Menu with dropdowns and a side, full-screen, top or bottom mobile panel, Search Form inline or as an icon opening a popup search, Copyright). While you design a single post or product template, the editor shows one of your real posts or products.

As in Elementor Pro, post widgets appear in Single templates and product widgets in Single Product templates; site widgets, Blog Posts, Advanced Product Grid, Breadcrumb and Cart Icon work everywhere. Works with classic themes (Hello Elementor, Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP…) and block themes (Twenty Twenty-Five).

Form Builder

The Form widget builds any form with full style controls for labels, fields, checkboxes, buttons, steps and messages.

  • 17 field types: text, email, textarea, phone, URL, number, date, time, drop-down (single or multiple), radio buttons, checkboxes, acceptance, password, file upload, hidden, HTML text and steps. Each field has a column width per device, placeholder, default value, help text and its own ID.
  • Multi-step forms with a progress bar or numbered steps with titles; each step is checked before moving on.
  • Conditional fields: show a field only when another field is, is not, contains, is empty or is not empty.
  • File uploads with allowed types, size and number of files. Files are stored with random names in a folder that can’t run scripts.
  • Actions after submit: save to Themofy Addons → Submissions, email, confirmation email to the visitor, redirect and webhook (Zapier, Make, n8n…). Emails use merge tags such as [field id="email"] and [all-fields], with From, Reply-To, Cc and Bcc.
  • Submissions page: list, search, filter by form, read / unread, delete and CSV export. Submissions are included in WordPress’s personal data export and erase tools.
  • Spam protection without third-party services: honeypot, minimum time before sending and an optional math question.

WooCommerce Checkout Builder

The Checkout widget shows WooCommerce’s own checkout, so payment gateways, coupons, shipping and order emails keep working, in a layout you design.

  • Layouts: order summary on the right, left, above or below, sticky if you like. The layout uses its own grid, so theme styles can’t break it.
  • Two-step checkout (optional): details first (checked before moving on), then payment with a summary of the details. Numbers, breadcrumb or progress bar as the step indicator.
  • Payment methods in the order summary or below the customer details.
  • Field editor for billing, shipping and additional fields: drag to reorder, change labels and placeholders, add default values and help texts, make fields required or optional, hide them, and set each field’s width per device (100%, 75%, 66%, 50%, 33%, 25% or a custom width).
  • Custom checkout fields (text, textarea, drop-down, radio, checkbox, email, phone, number, date) saved on the order and shown in the order screen, WooCommerce emails and the customer’s order details.
  • Order summary: product images with quantity badges, an “Edit cart” link and a coupon field right in the summary (or WooCommerce’s coupon link above the checkout), and your own texts for the headings and the Place Order button.
  • Style everything: sections, headings, labels, fields, steps, the order summary, payment methods, the Place Order button and notices.

General widgets

Building blocks for any page, each with full style controls.

  • Heading — write words in double braces, like Build pages that {{stand out}}, to style them on their own, with drawn-in effects (underline, marker, circle, zigzag…), an optional sub title, description and separator.
  • Creative Button — 23 hover effects (liquid fill, border beam, gradient flow, neon, letter wave, glitch, magnetic, pointer spotlight…), repeating attention animations, a click ripple and layered shadows. Follows your Site Settings button style and global colors and fonts. The icon has its own style.
  • Icon List — icons, your own SVGs, images or short texts such as numbers, with descriptions and links, as a list, inline or grid.
  • Accordion — icons or images beside the titles, rich content with an image, one or several items open, your own toggle icons, three designs and optional FAQ schema.
  • Category Grid — product or post categories, tags or any taxonomy as a grid or list, with image, count, description and button, nine designs and seven hover effects.
  • Advanced Slider — slides with an image, video or color background, overlay, heading, text, two buttons and a side image. Eight templates, seven effects, slides per view per device, autoplay with a progress bar, Ken Burns, text animations, and many arrow and pagination styles.
  • Testimonials — carousel, grid, masonry or marquee in eight templates, with photo, name, role, company, logo, rating and badge. Build your own card: drag the parts into any order and give each a width to place them side by side.
  • Creative Gallery — any layout: a grid where each item has its own size, nine patterns (bento, metro, magazine…), masonry, justified rows or a free canvas. Drag items to size and place them in the editor. Images, videos and text tiles from your list, the Media Library or posts, with filters, Load More, lightbox, captions and hover effects.
  • Animated Progress — bars, circles, gauges with a needle or segments in six designs, filling and counting up as they come into view or as the page scrolls, plus a reading progress bar at the top.
  • Timeline — zigzag, one side or horizontal, with dot, icon, number or date markers and five designs; the line fills as visitors scroll. Your own events or posts.
  • Marquee — an endless strip of texts, logos and icons with icon, symbol, image, dot or line separators: ribbons, tilted or crossed ribbons, outlined or gradient text, up to three rows in any direction, slow down or pause on hover, speed up while scrolling.
  • Circle Text — text around a circle with an icon, image or text in the middle. Spin and scroll motion; the middle animates separately.
  • Off-Canvas — a side, top, bottom or popup panel you design right on the page with any widgets, opened by its button or any link.

Blog widgets

Design your blog page, archives and single posts. Every widget has full style controls.

  • Blog Posts — six ready-made designs, as cards, a list or overlays. Show the posts of the page being viewed or choose them by post type, category, tag, IDs, order and offset, with badge, meta, excerpt, Read More button and pagination.
  • Archive Title — the category, tag, author, date or search title with its description.
  • Post Title, Featured Image (ratio, link, lightbox, caption, fallback image) and Post Excerpt.
  • Post Meta — author with photo, date, last updated, categories, tags, comments, reading time and custom text, in any order, each with its own label and icon.
  • Post Content — the post content, with styles for text, links, headings, quotes, images and lists.
  • Post Terms — categories, tags or any taxonomy, as text, pills or a list.
  • Author Box — photo, name, biography and a link to the author’s posts.
  • Post Navigation — previous and next post, with titles, arrows and thumbnails.
  • Related Posts — posts from the same category or with the same tags.
  • Post Comments — the comment list and form, fully styled.

WooCommerce widgets

Build your own product pages, shop and cart icon, with full style controls for every part.

  • Advanced Product Grid — products on any page, with five ready-made designs (Elevated Card, Outline, Minimal, Soft and Dark): latest, featured, on sale, best selling, top rated or hand-picked, filtered by category and tag, with columns per device and optional pagination. Or build your own card: choose and order the parts, set their widths to place them side by side, add a custom button and an image background.
  • Product Title — any heading tag, optional link.
  • Product Images — WooCommerce’s gallery with zoom, lightbox and thumbnail slider, optional slider arrows, thumbnail columns and sale flash.
  • Product Featured Image — the main image alone, any size, linked to the product or opened in a lightbox, with hover effects.
  • Product Price — sale and regular price styled separately, inline or stacked, currency symbol and price suffix.
  • Add to Cart — quantity, button, variation choices, grouped products and stock, side by side or stacked.
  • Add to Cart Button — the Creative Button that adds any product to the cart from any page, with quantity and redirect.
  • Product Rating, Product Stock (colors for in stock, out of stock and backorder) and Sale Badge (with the discount percentage).
  • Short Description and Product Description.
  • Product Meta (SKU, categories and tags with your own labels), Product Categories and Product Tags (as text, pills or a list).
  • Additional Information — the attributes table, with striped rows.
  • Product Tabs — normal, hover and active tab styles, and the panel.
  • Product Reviews — the reviews list and the review form, fully styled.
  • Related Products — related products or upsells, with columns per device and the same ready-made designs.
  • Products Archive — the shop grid with result count, sorting, pagination and the same ready-made designs.
  • WooCommerce Breadcrumb and Cart Icon (live item count and subtotal, your own icon).

Product widgets show the product being viewed (or one picked by its ID) and print WooCommerce’s own templates and hooks, so themes and extensions keep working.

Dynamic Tags

Dynamic tags let a widget field show live site data. Free Elementor has the system but no tags; Themofy Addons provides them, for text, links, images, galleries, colors and numbers, in classic and Elementor 4 (V4) widgets.

  • Post: Post Title, Post Excerpt, Post URL, Post ID, Post Date, Post Time, Post Terms, Reading Time, Featured Image, Featured Image Data, Post Attached Images.
  • Archive: Archive Title, Archive Description, Archive URL.
  • Site: Site Title, Site Tagline, Site URL, Site Logo, Page Title, Current Date Time, Request Parameter, Shortcode.
  • Author: Author Name, Author Info, Author URL, Author Profile Picture.
  • User (the logged-in visitor): User Info, User Profile Picture.
  • Comments: Comments Number, Comments URL.
  • Custom Fields: Custom Field (text, link, number or color), Custom Field Image, Custom Field Gallery — any custom field (Meta Box, Pods, plain WordPress meta…) from the current post, archive term, post author, logged-in user or an ACF options page.
  • ACF (when Advanced Custom Fields is active): ACF Field, ACF URL, ACF Image, ACF Gallery. Pick the field from the list; values come out ready to use (images, links, choices, dates, Group sub fields).
  • Links: Contact URL (email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Viber, Skype, Google Maps, Waze), Internal URL, Login / Logout URL.
  • WooCommerce (when WooCommerce is active): Product Title, Product Price, Product Sale Badge, Product Short Description, Product SKU, Product Stock, Product Rating, Product Attribute, Product Data, Product Image, Product Gallery, Product Category Image, Add To Cart URL, Store Page URL, Cart Info.

Every product tag works with the current product or a product picked by ID. Any tag can be switched off under Themofy Addons → Dynamic Tags.

Themofy Addons is an independent plugin. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elementor Ltd., WooCommerce or Advanced Custom Fields.

External services

Only the Import Google Fonts screen (Themofy Addons → Custom Fonts) uses outside services, and only when an administrator opens it:

  • WordPress.org font collection — the list of Google Fonts and its preview images come from the font collection that WordPress itself provides (s.w.org), the same one the Site Editor uses. Requested when the screen loads, and kept for a week. WordPress.org privacy policy.
  • Google Fonts (fonts.gstatic.com) — when you click Import, the font files you chose are downloaded once to your Media Library. No site or visitor data is sent, and your pages never load anything from Google for these fonts. Google Fonts privacy FAQ, Google privacy policy.
